newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo has no comment on sale date.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo has no comment on sale date.

text.p: Italy's largest commercial bank Istituto Bancario San Polo di Torino had no comment to make on press speculation its planned public sale offer would get underway on May 16, a bank spokesman said.
Financial sources said the May date was fairly plausible but the final timetable had yet to be set.
The board of San Paolo Holding said on Tuesday it was initiating steps for the public offer of San Paolo shares.
San Paolo Holding is controlled by the San Paolo foundation, while the Holding in turn controls the San Paolo banking group which is in the process of privatisation.

The operation will be in the form of a public share offer for around 25 percent of the bank's shares, while there will also be a private placing to Italian and foreign institutional investors for a further 20 percent of the shares.
